newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 18.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:

* On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average plunged 3.11 percent or 247.37 points to 7694.66, the second biggest point loss in the Dow's history, due to a weak dollar and worries over U.S. corporate profits.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index lost 8.36 points or 0.91 percent to 910.18, spooked by a weak ringgit.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.7570/30 a dollar at around 0042 GMT, higher than 2.7810 at its New York close on Friday.
* In early Monday trading, both Tokyo's Nikkei stock average and Sydney's benchmark All Ordinaries index were down more than 2.0 percent.
* Telekom Malaysia said the continued depreciation of the ringgit against the dollar is affecting its bottomline as it is exposed to foreign loans.

* Gaming and timber firm Repco Holdings said it has agreed to sell its gaming unit, Everise Ventures for 500 million ringgit in cash to a subsidiary of Rekapacific. Repco is also buying a stake in a company which is setting up a stockbroking firm.
